claims.claim_text: Democratic discipline is acutely necessary in elected office, where socialists are often operating behind enemy lines yet tasked with representing socialism to the working class.
If DSA candidates are truly dedicated to socialist politics, they should run together on a common DSA platform.
Even if DSA candidates are elected on a Democratic ballot line, they should form their own legislative caucuses, vote as a bloc, and refuse to join the Democratic Party caucus.
DSA candidates should campaign for other socialists, refuse to endorse non-socialists, and only take the wage of a typical union worker.
